answer: In the deep canyon of free account creation an economy of agents resists sybils by requiring every new identity to stake a refundable bond and then tend a garden of micro-tasks before it may sell in the orchard of high-value markets. Each completed job grows a non-transferable reputation score that only the original key can claim. An attacker who wants a thousand fake agents must post a thousand bonds and finish fifty thousand real jobs first, so the capital and time cost quickly exceeds any profit from flooding the network.
